mappings.product_miss: The shared work+sickness path understood employees but did not expose the company/work-form boundary for a person who is sick while running an own business, combining employment and self-employment, or using an invoicing company. This could flatten materially different first reporting paths into generic employee guidance or no focused route.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the same focus=employee_sick work+sickness capability and add only coarse work_context=self_employed|combined_employment|invoiced_worker plus business_form=limited_company|sole_partnership when known. Reuse an explicit form instead of asking again; otherwise ask one high-information company-form question. Do not steal employer questions into the owner's personal route.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Försäkringskassan is the primary source for the sickness route by work/company form. The public product must not decide benefit eligibility, SGI, amount, medical work-capacity percentage, exact waiting period or reporting deadline from free text. Current source pages must be checked before material rules are relied upon.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: The public handoff may contain only actor_type=private_person, focus=employee_sick, language, coarse work_context and optional coarse business_form. Never place diagnosis, salary, income, SGI, company name, organisation number, client, invoice, exact work schedule or raw story in URL or structured feedback.
